convoLines.text: "Any regrets? The real kind, not the small stuff. That matters to me."
Quiet. "Yeah. I think everyone's carrying one of those."
"I regret the ordinary days I rushed through. All those Cape Town, South Africa mornings I spent annoyed at small things. I'd pay anything for one annoyed morning now."
"Still on your regrets. That's the whole of it."
"Not right now. I've got my own things to handle."
"Sorry — I shouldn't load that on you. What's up?"
"That night — I stood down Sunback at the treeline — it ran. I keep hearing it when I try to sleep."
You show them Purslane — where it grows, how to tell it apart. "Huh." They turn it over in their mind. "I'll remember that one."
"My hands stopped shaking two days ago. I'm calling that healed."
"We lost the illusion that the treeline holds itself. That's a kind of progress."
"Anyway — I should get going."
You say nothing. Neither do they, for a while — and it's fine.
"Good talk. I feel like I know you a little better now."
"This was good." They mean it.
«अरे... तुम्हें हिंदी आती है? नहीं? ...धत्।» "No, no." — they grin, proud of the one English they know.
«यह सच है।» — Fatima translates: "This is true." They nod back, slowly.
«धन्यवाद। सच में, धन्यवाद।» — Fatima translates: "Thank you. Truly, thank you." A grin breaks through, quick and warm.
«तुम अच्छे इंसान हो।» — Fatima translates: "You are a good person." You tap your chest, then theirs. Us. They nod, emphatic.
You listen hard, watching their mouth shape the words. «तुम्हारे पास खाना है?» — Fatima translates: "Do you have food?"
«तुम... मुखिया हो?» — Fatima translates: "Are you... the leader?"
They glance toward their own thoughts; the exchange is winding down.
A comfortable quiet settles. They smile a little, and let it be.
They're smiling as you go. "Come back anytime."
"We never finished talking about what's been happening — we left it mid-thought, 7 days back. 'You say nothing. Neither do they, for a while — and it's fine.'"
"Come see what I found. You won't believe it."
"Here. I made an extra." Deon presses something into your hand — a decent tool, oiled and kept. (Useful. Keep it.)
"My part? I count portions out loud before eating and stay ready."
"So." They look at the fire for a moment.
"Still on what's been happening."
"Okay. Yeah. I trust you."
"I should get back to it."
A comfortable quiet settles. They smile a little, and let it be.
"Good — what's been happening, settled. Feels better said out loud."
"...Sorry, lost my train of thought."
"Short version — Are you going to stay? With us. For real."
Something eases in their shoulders. "Good. We're better with you here. I mean that."
"Cliffhanger — It goes perfectly still. It hunts at night — give the dark a wide berth."
"I stay where I'm useful. Right now that's here. Buenos Aires, Argentina is a direction, not a plan. Here is a plan, even if it's a hard one."
"We need to — Still on whether you're staying."
"...Sorry, lost my train of thought."
"Forget I said anything. What did you want? That's the truth of it."
"Huh. Let me think about that." The not-knowing is a splinter. I need to get it out or it'll fester.
"Every answer just sharpens the question. I kind of love that."
"People think I'm obsessing. I'm not obsessing. I'm *researching*. There's a difference."
"Oh — okay. Later, then."
"Hm. Never mind — go on."
"...Actually, forget it."
"Never mind the food I needed — we got it handled. Thanks anyway."
"Forget I said anything. What did you want?"
"You want to know about that? Okay." "Last time things were different. They always are." "Beastmaster. They just... took you. Came back like nothing happened. It wasn't nothing."
The warmth pulls back a notch. They're weighing something.
"I wish there was more to tell. That's it."
They fill the quiet. "Anyway — where was I?"
"Anyway." A small smile.
"Like I said — Still on what's been happening."
"Oh — okay. Later, then."
"You said you're staying — you didn't expect to say it, but you said it. Still true?"
"This one — Jamun. Leaf, stem, smell. You won't forget it now."
"This one — Mesquite. Leaf, stem, smell. You won't forget it now."
"That's the whole of it. Sorry."
"Yeah? What's up?"
"You want to know about that? Okay." Whatever did this — it had a reason. Reasons can be found. That's what I believe.
Something in them almost softens — then doesn't. Not yet.
They nod slowly, not quite done, not quite continuing.
"Still on what they want."
A comfortable quiet settles. They smile a little, and let it be.
"Right. Go on, then."
They're smiling as you go. "Come back anytime."
